description:
The Land Use designations are defined by Schedule C of the District's [Official Community Plan](https://www.summerland.ca/planning-building/official-community-plan) (OCP). A list of amendments can be found in section 28 of the [Summerland Official Community Plan](https://www.summerland.ca/docs/default-source/default-document-library/2014-ocp---schedule-a-consolidated-to-2021-09-13.pdf?sfvrsn=5698cefb_0). The corresponding bylaw number and adoption date are also captured in this dataset. 
The online information is provided for the convenience of our residents and clients and should not be used as a reference in decision-making when buying real estate, finalizing development proposals or seeking building permits. Please [contact](https://www.summerland.ca/your-city-hall/contact) the Development Services Department for more information.

The District's description above references a document whose link on summerland.ca no longer resolves, so the reference is given as plain text rather than a broken link.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS object identifier assigned by the source service. Stable within one extract; not a durable key across refreshes.

table:columns.name: NewOCPLandUse
table:columns.description: Official Community Plan land use designation. The District's Hub page describes this layer as OCP Schedule C while the live service names the layer "Land Use (OCP Schedule D)"; both are recorded and this mirror does not choose between them. Measured in this copy: 5207 of 5207 rows populated; 13 distinct values.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS GlobalID assigned by the source service. More stable across refreshes than OBJECTID.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, in EPSG:26911 (NAD83 / UTM zone 11N) as the District publishes it. Reproject to EPSG:4326 to join against WGS84 data.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box, the GeoParquet 1.1 covering used for spatial predicate pushdown. Derived, not upstream data.

title: Official Community Plan Land Use
